name: Optimize qni-webgpu GitHub Actions CI runtime

description: Baseline projected CI critical path from the current single-job workflow using latest successful Actions setup timings plus fresh local check durations.

asi.hypothesis: Current single-job CI serializes web, mcp, and tui checks behind two expensive cargo-install setup steps, so job topology is the highest-leverage first optimization.
asi.next_action_hint: Try splitting the workflow into parallel jobs that separate trunk/web setup from cargo-audit-deny/tui setup.
